action_items: Documentation: review request referenced route '/create' but actual wizard route is '/new' — no code change needed, just a note for future test agents / PRD alignment.
Minor: /login page emits ERR_NAME_NOT_RESOLVED in console (likely Google OAuth prefetch or missing host) — pre-existing, not iter-17 related. Verify Google OAuth login flow when time permits.
critical_code_review_comments: Duration chip testids follow inconsistent pattern (duration-chip-30sec, 45sec, 60sec, 90sec vs duration-chip-2, 3, 5, 10 for minute variants). Not a bug, but consistent naming (e.g., duration-chip-2min) would improve test selector clarity.

Landing.jsx STEPS array uses dangerouslySetInnerHTML for body copy with HTML entities like ' — could be replaced with plain strings using unicode quotes to avoid XSS-adjacent patterns even for static content.

ProjectWizard uses two sources of truth for durations (FALLBACK_DURATIONS constant + /api/durations fetch) — labels differ between hero ('30s') and wizard ('30 sec'); consider standardizing on backend response.
